data: Existing SHA-pinned 20 alt arrays + ONLY new BTCUSDT 1d/4h from Binance USD-M; 2023 warmup, 2024..2026 Oct evaluation.
reference_model: RESET-07 §5.1 LIMIT-touch 7d; preserve ticket, fees, stop, runner and existing kill-touch behavior, no optimization

window.day_D: Use only completed day D-1 candles for conditions; never D
window.btc: BTC daily close[D-1] > SMA50 inclusive of D-1 AND BTC close[D-1]/close[D-31] >1
window.breadth: At least 6 of exactly 10 alt symbols with close[D-1]/close[D-31]>1; newly-listed or insufficient histories count FALSE
window.volatility: For each completed day t, cross-asset median among >=6 valid ATR14 Wilder 1d(t)/close(t) from existing alt arrays; compare value D-1 strictly > median of preceding 365 daily cross-sectional medians D-366..D-2; require all 365 days or unclassifiable
window.hysteresis: Start CLOSED. 3 true opens; >=2 false closes; otherwise retain. Unclassifiable days disallow entries in both arms and reset CLOSED.
window.entry: At NEXT 4h opening after completed breakout alarm, check day's gate. Place LIMIT only in qualifying regime, same old price/TTL. Pending LIMIT canceled upon regime mismatch before touch on subsequent bars, exits for filled tickets always unconditional.
window.control: CONTROL means opposite of OPEN on classifiable days; no entries if unclassifiable.
window.calendar: 2024-01-01 .. 2026-10-31: share open days / 1035 total days, report unclassifiable separately

verdict: WINDOW_WORKS if PRIMARY PF>1.3, >=40 closed tickets, CONTROL PF<=1.05, PRIMARY DD<=30%, 15%-40% open days inclusive. WINDOW_DEAD if PRIMARY PF<=1.3 OR CONTROL PF>1.05 OR PRIMARY N<40 OR window share>60%. Otherwise GAP_NOT_PROVEN.
caveats: Rule designed from known winning windows, results in-sample, pass only hypothesis for prospective forward testing; 4h OHLC limit touch only, same old TP and kill fidelity caveats.
